_readme: RCF Online Academy - the single place where class information is kept.
TWO LISTS ARE IN THIS FILE:
courses  - the KINDS of class offered. Set "published": false to hide a kind
completely. Hidden kinds disappear from the menu and from the site,
so there are never empty pages for classes that are not offered.
classes  - the ACTUAL classes. Add one entry per class you are running.
NEVER write a day, time, fee, location or number of places that has not been
decided. Leave the field out, or use one of these honest phrases:
registration may be: open | soon | waitlist | closed
delivery may be:     online | physical | hybrid
After editing this file, run build.cmd.

courses.title: Physical Classes
courses._note: Hidden. Classes are conducted mainly online at present. Change to true only when physical classes are actually being held, and add the real venue to the class entries below.

classes.title: O/L English
classes.subject: O/L English
description: Systematic preparation for the Ordinary Level English paper, covering grammar, vocabulary, reading comprehension and every writing task in the examination, with guided practice before independent work.
classes.audience: School candidates and private candidates preparing for O/L English
classes.language: English, with explanation in simple language where needed
classes.materials: A notebook, a pen and a device with an internet connection

classes.title: O/L English Literature
classes.subject: O/L English Literature
description: Close study of the prescribed poems, short stories, plays and novels, with practice in context answers and full essay answers, and individual correction of written work.
classes.materials: The prescribed texts, a notebook and a device with an internet connection

classes.title: A/L English Literature
classes.subject: A/L English Literature
description: Advanced Level Literature: close reading, critical appreciation, selecting and using textual evidence, and building well-organised essay answers under examination conditions.
classes.audience: Advanced Level students of English Literature
classes.materials: The prescribed texts and a device with an internet connection

classes.title: General English
classes.subject: General English
description: Practical English for daily life, study and work: grammar you actually use, everyday vocabulary, reading and writing, and the confidence to use English without fear of mistakes.
classes.audience: Adult learners, school leavers and anyone rebuilding their English
classes.materials: A notebook and a device with an internet connection

classes.title: Spoken English
classes.subject: Spoken English
description: Speaking practice built around real situations: introductions, telephone calls, interviews, workplace conversation, travel and everyday social exchanges, with correction and pronunciation guidance.
classes.audience: Adults and older students who understand English but hesitate to speak
classes.materials: A device with a working microphone

classes.title: Examination Revision
classes.subject: O/L English, O/L Literature and A/L Literature
description: Short, focused revision courses before the examination: paper structure, timing, answer development, common mistakes and practice on past and model papers.
classes.audience: Candidates in their examination year, including private candidates

classes.title: Individual Classes
classes.subject: English or Literature, according to need
description: One-to-one teaching arranged around a single learner: the pace, the content and the amount of correction are all decided by what that learner needs. Suitable for students who need extra help, and for adults who prefer to learn privately.
classes.audience: Learners who need individual attention or a flexible time

classes.title: Group Classes
classes.subject: English and Literature
description: Small-group teaching in which learners work through explanations, guided practice and correction together. Group classes give learners the benefit of hearing other people's questions and answers.
classes.audience: Students who learn well alongside others
